## aa time plot
```{r}

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
select <- dplyr::select  
# Import the CSV file
df <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/TBD cases/Temporal Data/aa.csv"
)

# Create date variable
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(paste(disease_year, disease_month, "01", sep = "-"))
  )

# Aggregate monthly cases
monthly_cases <- df %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(total_cases = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE))

# Final publication-quality plot
aa <- ggplot(monthly_cases, aes(x = date, y = total_cases)) +
  geom_line(color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 year",
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
  y = expression(bold("Cases by " * italic("A. americanum")))
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

print(aa)


# Aggregate cases by month (across all years)
month_cases <- df %>%
  group_by(disease_year, disease_month) %>%
  summarise(total_cases = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(disease_year, disease_month)

# Smooth seasonal curve WITH points from all years
aa_smooth <- ggplot(month_cases, aes(x = disease_month, y = total_cases)) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "firebrick",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    span = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun",
               "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"),
    limits = c(1, 12),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = expression(bold("Cases by " * italic("A. americanum")))
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", face = "bold")
  )

print(aa_smooth)



### Aggregate cases by Month in data frame formate

monthly_tbd_aa <- df %>%
  group_by(disease_month) %>%
  summarise(aa_tbd = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  right_join(
    data.frame(disease_month = 1:12),
    by = "disease_month"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    aa_tbd = ifelse(is.na(aa_tbd), 0, aa_tbd),
    Month = factor(disease_month,
                   levels = 1:12,
                   labels = c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun",
                              "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(disease_month) %>%
  select(Month, aa_tbd)

monthly_tbd_aa
#View(monthly_tbd_aa)

```

## Climate DATA
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)

base  <- "https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/data/nclimgrid-daily/access/averages"
years <- 2019:2022

read_month_il <- function(var, year, month){
  ym  <- sprintf("%04d%02d", year, month)
  url <- sprintf("%s/%04d/%s-%s-ste-scaled.csv", base, year, var, ym)

  x <- read_csv(url, show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "minimal")
  names(x)[1:6] <- c("region_type","region_code","region_name","year","month","variable")

  il <- x[x$region_name == "Illinois", ]
  if (nrow(il) == 0) stop("Illinois row not found in: ", url)

  # day columns = everything after first 6 cols
  day_mat <- il[, 7:ncol(il), drop = FALSE]

  # pivot with column index -> day number (robust even if names are messed up)
  out <- tibble(
    day = seq_len(ncol(day_mat)),
    value = as.numeric(day_mat[1, ])
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      date = make_date(year = year, month = month, day = day),
      !!var := ifelse(value <= -999, NA_real_, value)
    ) %>%
    select(date, all_of(var))

  out
}

tavg_daily <- bind_rows(lapply(years, \(y) bind_rows(lapply(1:12, \(m) read_month_il("tavg", y, m)))))
prcp_daily <- bind_rows(lapply(years, \(y) bind_rows(lapply(1:12, \(m) read_month_il("prcp", y, m)))))

daily <- full_join(tavg_daily, prcp_daily, by = "date") %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  filter(date >= as.Date("2019-01-01"), date <= as.Date("2022-12-31"))

write_csv(
  daily,
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Climate data/illinois_daily_temp_prcp_2019_2022.csv"
)

daily

####AVERGAE DAILY COMBINED OF 4 YEARS#######

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)

df <- read_csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Climate data/illinois_daily_temp_prcp_2019_2022.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# robust date parse: handle "1/1/2019" or "2019-01-01" etc.
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    date_chr = as.character(date),
    date = suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(date_chr, orders = c("mdy", "ymd", "m/d/Y", "Y-m-d")))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date)) %>%
  select(-date_chr)

# 365-row average by calendar day across 2019-2022 (drop Feb 29)
daily_365 <- df %>%
  mutate(mmdd = format(as.Date(date), "%m-%d")) %>%
  filter(mmdd != "02-29") %>%
  group_by(mmdd) %>%
  summarise(
    tavg_C_mean  = mean(tavg, na.rm = TRUE),
    prcp_mm_mean = mean(prcp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(fake_date = as.Date(paste0("2019-", mmdd), format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  arrange(fake_date) %>%
  select(mmdd, tavg_C_mean, prcp_mm_mean)

write_csv(
  daily_365,
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Climate data/illinois_daily_365avg_2019_2022.csv"
)

daily_365

```

##Plot climate data
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

clim <- read_csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Climate data/illinois_daily_climate.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(fake_date = as.Date(paste0("2019-", mmdd))) %>%
  arrange(fake_date)

# scale precip onto temp axis (for dual axis)
t_range <- range(clim$tavg_C_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
p_range <- range(clim$prcp_mm_mean, na.rm = TRUE)

scale_factor <- diff(t_range) / diff(p_range)
offset       <- t_range[1] - p_range[1] * scale_factor

clim <- clim %>% mutate(prcp_scaled = prcp_mm_mean * scale_factor + offset)

p <- ggplot(clim, aes(x = fake_date)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = prcp_mm_mean), fill = "goldenrod", width = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = tavg_C_mean), color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_x_date(
  name = "Month",
  limits = as.Date(c("2019-01-01", "2019-12-31")),  # <-- force Jan–Dec only
  date_breaks = "1 month",
  date_labels = "%b",
  expand = c(0, 0)                                  # <-- no extra padding
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Precipitation (mm)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - offset) / scale_factor,
                        name = "Temperature (°C)")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.y.left  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, colour = "black"),

    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black", face = "plain"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 1.2),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# add a small manual key (top-left)
temp_prec_Plot <- p +
  annotate("segment",
           x = min(clim$fake_date) + 10, xend = min(clim$fake_date) + 35,
           y = max(clim$prcp_mm_mean, na.rm = TRUE) * 2,   # moved up
           yend = max(clim$prcp_mm_mean, na.rm = TRUE) * 2,
           colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(clim$fake_date) + 40,
           y = max(clim$prcp_mm_mean, na.rm = TRUE) * 2,
           label = "Temperature",
           hjust = 0, size = 6, colour = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("segment",
           x = min(clim$fake_date) + 10, xend = min(clim$fake_date) + 35,
           y = max(clim$prcp_mm_mean, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.85,   # moved up
           yend = max(clim$prcp_mm_mean, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.85,
           colour = "goldenrod", linewidth = 1.2) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(clim$fake_date) + 40,
           y = max(clim$prcp_mm_mean, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.85,
           label = "Precipitation",
           hjust = 0, size = 6, colour = "black", fontface = "bold")

ggsave(
  "Illinois_Climatology_Temp_Precip_2019_2022.png",
  temp_prec_Plot,
  path = "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Output",
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

print(temp_prec_Plot)

```

```{r}
) %>%
  mutate(fake_date = as.Date(paste0("2019-", mmdd))) %>%
```

##aa_exp
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

# Import the tick exposure CSV file
aa_exp <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Tick bite/Temporal Data/aa_exp.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Make sure types are correct + create monthly date
aa_exp <- aa_exp %>%
  mutate(
    year  = as.integer(year),
    month = as.integer(month),
    count = as.numeric(count),
    month_date = as.Date(paste(year, month, "01", sep = "-"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(month_date), !is.na(count))


## Time-series plot by Year (monthly totals)

monthly_exp <- aa_exp %>%
  group_by(month_date) %>%
  summarise(total_cases = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(month_date)

aa_exp_ts <- ggplot(monthly_exp, aes(x = month_date, y = total_cases)) +
  geom_line(color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
  scale_x_date(
    limits = as.Date(c("2019-01-01", "2022-12-31")),
    breaks = seq(as.Date("2019-01-01"), as.Date("2022-01-01"), by = "1 year"),
    date_labels = "%Y",
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = expression(bold("Tick bites by " * italic("D. variabillis")))
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.line    = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.text    = element_text(color = "black", size = 11),
    axis.title.x = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

print(aa_exp_ts)


## Seasonal plot (keep every year-month point) + loess smooth

month_cases <- aa_exp %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
```

## combine all monthly average data from tbd and tick bite
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# Merge all 9 data frames
dfs <- list(
  is_exp_monthly,
  dv_exp_monthly,
  aa_exp_monthly,
  monthly_tbd_is,
  monthly_tbd_dv,
  monthly_tbd_aa,
  is_samp_monthly,
  dv_samp_monthly,
  aa_samp_monthly
)

merged_df <- reduce(dfs, full_join, by = "Month")

# Export raw merged
write.csv(
  merged_df,
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Temporal data/merged_monthly_6dfs.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Phenology = tick bites + TBD cases + sampled ticks
merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    is_phen = is_exp + is_tbd + is_samp,
    dv_phen = dv_exp + dv_tbd + dv_samp,
    aa_phen = aa_exp + aa_tbd + aa_samp
  )

# Z-score
merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    is_phen_z = as.numeric(scale(is_phen)),
    dv_phen_z = as.numeric(scale(dv_phen)),
    aa_phen_z = as.numeric(scale(aa_phen))
  )

# Scale 0.01-0.99
scale_01 <- function(x) {
  q_low  <- quantile(x, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  q_high <- quantile(x, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(q_low) || is.na(q_high) || q_high == q_low) return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  x <- pmin(pmax(x, q_low), q_high)
  scaled <- (x - q_low) / (q_high - q_low)
  scaled * 0.98 + 0.01
}

merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    is_phen_scal = scale_01(is_phen),
    dv_phen_scal = scale_01(dv_phen),
    aa_phen_scal = scale_01(aa_phen)
  )

head(merged_df)

# Export full
write.csv(
  merged_df,
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Temporal data/merged_monthly_phen_scaled.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Export scaled only

  dplyr::select(Month, is_phen_scal, dv_phen_scal, aa_phen_scal)

write.csv(
```

##Phenology curve
```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# read your phenology table (edit path)
phen <- read_csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Temporal data/merged_monthly_phen_scaled.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

#  make Month ordered + long format
month_levels <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")

phen_long <- phen %>%
  mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = month_levels)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(is_phen_scal, dv_phen_scal, aa_phen_scal),
    names_to = "tick",
    values_to = "phen"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tick = recode(tick,
                  is_phen_scal = "I. scapularis",
                  dv_phen_scal = "D. variabilis",
                  aa_phen_scal = "A. americanum")
  )

# smooth each series (loess) so we can draw a nice curve + filled area under it
#    (Creates a fine x grid across months: 1..12)
smooth_df <- phen_long %>%
  mutate(mnum = as.numeric(Month)) %>%
  group_by(tick) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    dat <- .x
    fit <- loess(phen ~ mnum, data = dat, span = 0.6, degree = 2)
    grid <- data.frame(mnum = seq(1, 12, length.out = 300))
    grid$phen_smooth <- predict(fit, newdata = grid)
    grid$phen_smooth <- pmax(grid$phen_smooth, 0)  # keep >=0
    grid$phen_smooth <- pmin(grid$phen_smooth, 1)  # keep <=1 for scaled
    grid
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

#  plot: shaded area under each curve + line on top
tick_cols <- c(
  "I. scapularis"  = "goldenrod",
  "D. variabilis" = "firebrick",
  "A. americanum" = "steelblue4"
)

p_phen <- ggplot(
  smooth_df,
  aes(x = mnum, y = phen_smooth, fill = tick, color = tick)
) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.25, position = "identity") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = tick_cols) +
  scale_color_manual(values = tick_cols) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = month_levels,
    limits = c(1, 12),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    name = "Phenology"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Month", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(face = "italic")),
    color = guide_legend(label.theme = element_text(face = "italic"))
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.line    = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.text    = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

print(p_phen)
# 5) save
ggsave(
  filename = "Tick_Phenology_All3_Scaled_Shaded.png",
  plot = p_phen,
  path = "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Output",
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## importing climate data converting into monthwise data and merging with phenology data
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)

# Read 365-day climate data 
clim365 <- read_csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Climate data/illinois_daily_climate.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Convert daily mmdd -> monthly climate summaries (12 rows) ----
clim_month <- clim365 %>%
  mutate(
    # mmdd like "1-Jan" / "01-01" / "Jan-01" etc. -> robust parse using fake year
    fake_date = suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(mmdd, orders = c("d-b", "db", "m-d", "md"), tz = "UTC")),
    fake_date = if_else(is.na(fake_date), as.Date(paste0("2019-", mmdd)), as.Date(fake_date)),
    month_num = month(fake_date),
    Month     = month(fake_date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE) |> as.character()
  ) %>%
  group_by(month_num, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    tavg_C_month_mean  = mean(tavg_C_mean,  na.rm = TRUE),
    prcp_mm_month_mean = mean(prcp_mm_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    prcp_mm_month_sum  = sum(prcp_mm_mean,  na.rm = TRUE), 
    rh_month_mean      = mean(rh_mean,      na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(month_num) %>%
  dplyr::select(Month, month_num, tavg_C_month_mean, prcp_mm_month_mean, prcp_mm_month_sum, rh_month_mean)

#  Merge with phenology table and make 1-month lag climate vars ----
final_df <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    month_num = match(Month, month.abb)   # ensures correct Jan->Dec order
  ) %>%
  left_join(clim_month, by = c("Month", "month_num")) %>%
  arrange(month_num) %>%
  mutate(
    # 1-month lag (previous month). For Jan, lag comes from Dec.
    tavg_lag1  = dplyr::lag(tavg_C_month_mean,  1, default = last(tavg_C_month_mean)),
    prcpmean_lag1 = dplyr::lag(prcp_mm_month_mean, 1, default = last(prcp_mm_month_mean)),
    prcpsum_lag1  = dplyr::lag(prcp_mm_month_sum,  1, default = last(prcp_mm_month_sum)),
    rh_lag1 = dplyr::lag(rh_month_mean, 1, default = last(rh_month_mean))
  )

# check
print(final_df)
#View(final_df)

```

```{r}
## Auto-extract correlation table
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Helper functions
get_cor <- function(x, y, method = "spearman") {
  t <- cor.test(x, y, method = method)
  c(rho = round(t$estimate, 4), p_cor = round(t$p.value, 5))
}

get_lm <- function(formula, data) {
  m <- summary(lm(formula, data = data))
  beta <- round(m$coefficients[2, 1], 6)
  p    <- round(m$coefficients[2, 4], 5)
  r2   <- round(m$r.squared, 4)
  c(beta = beta, p_lm = p, R2 = r2)
}

# Build table
cor_table <- bind_rows(
  # NO LAG
  # IS
  c(Species="I. scapularis", Lag="No lag", Predictor="Temperature",
    get_cor(final_df$is_phen_scal, final_df$tavg_C_month_mean),
    get_lm(is_phen_scal ~ tavg_C_month_mean, final_df)),
  c(Species="I. scapularis", Lag="No lag", Predictor="Precipitation",
    get_cor(final_df$is_phen_scal, final_df$prcp_mm_month_sum),
    get_lm(is_phen_scal ~ prcp_mm_month_sum, final_df)),
  c(Species="I. scapularis", Lag="No lag", Predictor="Relative Humidity",
    get_cor(final_df$is_phen_scal, final_df$rh_month_mean),
    get_lm(is_phen_scal ~ rh_month_mean, final_df)),
  # DV
  c(Species="D. variabilis", Lag="No lag", Predictor="Temperature",
    get_cor(final_df$dv_phen_scal, final_df$tavg_C_month_mean),
    get_lm(dv_phen_scal ~ tavg_C_month_mean, final_df)),
  c(Species="D. variabilis", Lag="No lag", Predictor="Precipitation",
    get_cor(final_df$dv_phen_scal, final_df$prcp_mm_month_sum),
    get_lm(dv_phen_scal ~ prcp_mm_month_sum, final_df)),
  c(Species="D. variabilis", Lag="No lag", Predictor="Relative Humidity",
    get_cor(final_df$dv_phen_scal, final_df$rh_month_mean),
    get_lm(dv_phen_scal ~ rh_month_mean, final_df)),
  # AA
  c(Species="A. americanum", Lag="No lag", Predictor="Temperature",
    get_cor(final_df$aa_phen_scal, final_df$tavg_C_month_mean),
    get_lm(aa_phen_scal ~ tavg_C_month_mean, final_df)),
  c(Species="A. americanum", Lag="No lag", Predictor="Precipitation",
    get_cor(final_df$aa_phen_scal, final_df$prcp_mm_month_sum),
    get_lm(aa_phen_scal ~ prcp_mm_month_sum, final_df)),
  c(Species="A. americanum", Lag="No lag", Predictor="Relative Humidity",
    get_cor(final_df$aa_phen_scal, final_df$rh_month_mean),
    get_lm(aa_phen_scal ~ rh_month_mean, final_df)),

  # LAG 1 MONTH
  # IS
  c(Species="I. scapularis", Lag="Lag 1 month", Predictor="Temperature",
    get_cor(final_df$is_phen_scal, final_df$tavg_lag1),
    get_lm(is_phen_scal ~ tavg_lag1, final_df)),
  c(Species="I. scapularis", Lag="Lag 1 month", Predictor="Precipitation",
    get_cor(final_df$is_phen_scal, final_df$prcpsum_lag1),
    get_lm(is_phen_scal ~ prcpsum_lag1, final_df)),
  c(Species="I. scapularis", Lag="Lag 1 month", Predictor="Relative Humidity",
    get_cor(final_df$is_phen_scal, final_df$rh_lag1),
    get_lm(is_phen_scal ~ rh_lag1, final_df)),
  # DV
  c(Species="D. variabilis", Lag="Lag 1 month", Predictor="Temperature",
    get_cor(final_df$dv_phen_scal, final_df$tavg_lag1),
    get_lm(dv_phen_scal ~ tavg_lag1, final_df)),
  c(Species="D. variabilis", Lag="Lag 1 month", Predictor="Precipitation",
    get_cor(final_df$dv_phen_scal, final_df$prcpsum_lag1),
    get_lm(dv_phen_scal ~ prcpsum_lag1, final_df)),
  c(Species="D. variabilis", Lag="Lag 1 month", Predictor="Relative Humidity",
    get_cor(final_df$dv_phen_scal, final_df$rh_lag1),
    get_lm(dv_phen_scal ~ rh_lag1, final_df)),
  # AA
  c(Species="A. americanum", Lag="Lag 1 month", Predictor="Temperature",
    get_cor(final_df$aa_phen_scal, final_df$tavg_lag1),
    get_lm(aa_phen_scal ~ tavg_lag1, final_df)),
  c(Species="A. americanum", Lag="Lag 1 month", Predictor="Precipitation",
    get_cor(final_df$aa_phen_scal, final_df$prcpsum_lag1),
    get_lm(aa_phen_scal ~ prcpsum_lag1, final_df)),
  c(Species="A. americanum", Lag="Lag 1 month", Predictor="Relative Humidity",
    get_cor(final_df$aa_phen_scal, final_df$rh_lag1),
    get_lm(aa_phen_scal ~ rh_lag1, final_df))
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

## For Relative Humidity
```{r}

library(segmented); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)

# A. americanum (RH)
lm_aa_rh <- lm(aa_phen_scal ~ rh_month_mean, data = final_df)
jp_aa_rh <- segmented(lm_aa_rh, seg.Z = ~ rh_month_mean, npsi = 2)

new_rh_aa <- data.frame(
  rh_month_mean = seq(min(final_df$rh_month_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
                      max(final_df$rh_month_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
                      length.out = 200)
)

pr_rh_aa <- predict(jp_aa_rh, newdata = new_rh_aa, se.fit = TRUE)
new_rh_aa$fit <- pr_rh_aa$fit
new_rh_aa$lwr <- pr_rh_aa$fit - 1.96 * pr_rh_aa$se.fit
new_rh_aa$upr <- pr_rh_aa$fit + 1.96 * pr_rh_aa$se.fit
bp_aa_rh <- jp_aa_rh$psi[2]

final_df$Species <- "A. americanum"

p_aa_rh <- ggplot(final_df, aes(rh_month_mean, aa_phen_scal)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_ribbon(data = new_rh_aa,
              aes(x = rh_month_mean, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = .25) +
  geom_line(data = new_rh_aa,
            aes(x = rh_month_mean, y = fit),
            color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = bp_aa_rh, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = bp_aa_rh, y = max(final_df$aa_phen_scal, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = paste0("BP=", round(bp_aa_rh, 2)),
           hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Phenology") +
  facet_wrap(~Species) + my_theme


# D. variabilis 
# D. variabilis — use npsi=1 since RH signal is weaker for DV
lm_dv_rh <- lm(dv_phen_scal ~ rh_month_mean, data = final_df)
jp_dv_rh <- segmented(lm_dv_rh, seg.Z = ~ rh_month_mean, npsi = 1)

new_rh_dv <- data.frame(
  rh_month_mean = seq(min(final_df$rh_month_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
                      max(final_df$rh_month_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
                      length.out = 200)
)

pr_rh_dv <- predict(jp_dv_rh, newdata = new_rh_dv, se.fit = TRUE)
new_rh_dv$fit <- pr_rh_dv$fit
new_rh_dv$lwr <- pr_rh_dv$fit - 1.96 * pr_rh_dv$se.fit
new_rh_dv$upr <- pr_rh_dv$fit + 1.96 * pr_rh_dv$se.fit
bp_dv_rh <- jp_dv_rh$psi[1, 2]  # note: [1,2] for npsi=1

final_df$Species <- "D. variabilis"

p_dv_rh <- ggplot(final_df, aes(rh_month_mean, dv_phen_scal)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_ribbon(data = new_rh_dv,
              aes(x = rh_month_mean, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = .25) +
  geom_line(data = new_rh_dv,
            aes(x = rh_month_mean, y = fit),
            color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = bp_dv_rh, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = bp_dv_rh, y = max(final_df$dv_phen_scal, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = paste0("BP=", round(bp_dv_rh, 2)),
           hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Phenology") +
  facet_wrap(~Species) + my_theme


# I. scapularis 
lm_is_rh <- lm(is_phen_scal ~ rh_month_mean, data = final_df)
jp_is_rh <- segmented(lm_is_rh, seg.Z = ~ rh_month_mean, npsi = 2)

new_rh_is <- data.frame(
  rh_month_mean = seq(min(final_df$rh_month_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
                      max(final_df$rh_month_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
                      length.out = 200)
)

pr_rh_is <- predict(jp_is_rh, newdata = new_rh_is, se.fit = TRUE)
new_rh_is$fit <- pr_rh_is$fit
new_rh_is$lwr <- pr_rh_is$fit - 1.96 * pr_rh_is$se.fit
new_rh_is$upr <- pr_rh_is$fit + 1.96 * pr_rh_is$se.fit
bp_is_rh <- jp_is_rh$psi[2]

final_df$Species <- "I. scapularis"

p_is_rh <- ggplot(final_df, aes(rh_month_mean, is_phen_scal)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_ribbon(data = new_rh_is,
              aes(x = rh_month_mean, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = .25) +
  geom_line(data = new_rh_is,
            aes(x = rh_month_mean, y = fit),
            color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = bp_is_rh, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = bp_is_rh, y = max(final_df$is_phen_scal, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = paste0("BP=", round(bp_is_rh, 2)),
           hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Phenology") +

#Reulst summary
summary(jp_aa_rh)
summary(jp_dv_rh)
summary(jp_is_rh)

confint(jp_aa_rh)
confint(jp_dv_rh)
confint(jp_is_rh)

# Combine into one panel
# Make only left plot carry the shared Y label
p_aa_rh <- p_aa_rh + labs(y = "Phenology")
p_dv_rh <- p_dv_rh + labs(y = NULL)
p_is_rh <- p_is_rh + labs(y = NULL)

# Optional: hide y tick labels on middle/right to look cleaner
p_dv_rh <- p_dv_rh + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                           axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
p_is_rh <- p_is_rh + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                           axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

# 1 row, 3 columns + shared X label (same as your style)
rh_row <- p_aa_rh | p_dv_rh | p_is_rh

rh_panel <- rh_row / row_xlab("Mean monthly relative humidity (%)") +
  plot_layout(heights = c(10, 1.1))

rh_panel

ggsave(
```
